meta.title: family-tree: a private, collaborative family graph
meta.description: A private, collaborative family tree built as an interactive graph. Add people, connect parents and partners, and attach the photos and documents that hold the stories together. Free and open source.
common.languageDescription: Choose the language for the app.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.message: That request did not finish. Try again in a moment.
error.offline: You appear to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
error.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
error.notFound: That item could not be found.
error.server: The server had a problem. Please try again in a moment.
error.request: That request could not be completed. Try again.
error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
notFound.title: This branch does not exist
notFound.message: The page may have moved, or the tree may have been deleted.
auth.name: Your name
auth.layout.tagline: Every family has a shape. Map yours together.
auth.layout.taglineBody: A private, living graph of the people you come from. Invite the people who remember the stories, add photographs, and keep the branches growing.
auth.layout.privateByDefault: Private by default. Shared only by invitation.
auth.layout.dataPrivacy: Your family data stays private to the people you invite.
auth.error.linkCheck: We could not check this link
auth.error.linkCheck.reset: The link may still be good. Try again, or request a new one.
auth.error.linkCheck.verify: The link may still be good. Try again, or request a new one from account settings.
auth.error.linkCheck.email: The link may still be good. Try again, or request a new change from account settings.
auth.login.title: Welcome back
auth.login.subtitle: Sign in to add people, attach photos, and keep your family's stories connected.
auth.login.invited: You have been invited to join a family tree. Sign in or create an account to accept.
auth.register.title: Start your family tree
auth.register.subtitle: Create an account to start a family tree or accept an invitation to one.
auth.register.invited: Create an account, then you can accept the invitation.
auth.register.confirmation: We will send a link to confirm your email address. Your family data stays private in the meantime.
auth.register.legal: By creating an account you agree to the {terms} and the {privacy}.
auth.forgot.title: Forgot your password?
auth.forgot.subtitle: Enter the email address on your account and we will send a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgot.sentSubtitle: If that address belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way.
auth.forgot.sentBody: The link expires in one hour and works once. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder, then try again in a few minutes.
auth.forgot.privacyNote: For your privacy, we show the same message whether or not that address has an account.
auth.reset.title: Choose a new password
auth.reset.subtitle: Your reset link works once. After this, every other device is signed out.
auth.reset.used: This reset link has already been used.
auth.reset.invalid: This reset link is not valid.
auth.reset.signOutNote: Resetting your password signs you out everywhere else.
auth.verify.signedOutBody: Your email address is verified. Sign in to start building your family trees.
auth.verify.signedInBody: Your email address is verified. You can now send invitations to relatives.
auth.verify.expired: This verification link has expired. Sign in and ask for a new one.
auth.verify.invalid: This verification link is not valid. It may have been used already.
auth.verifyNotice.title: Confirm your email address
auth.verifyNotice.body: We sent a link to {email}. Confirm it to send invitations by email. You can keep using family-tree in the meantime.
auth.verifyNotice.simulated: Verification email printed to the server console. Resend configured servers deliver it by email.
auth.verifyNotice.sent: Verification link sent. Check your inbox.
auth.verifyNotice.failed: The email could not be sent. Try again later.
auth.changeEmail.changedBody: Your account now uses {email} for sign-in, invitations, and reminders.
auth.changeEmail.signInBody: This link changes the email address on your account. Sign in as the account owner to finish the change.
auth.changeEmail.wrongAccountBody: This link belongs to a different family-tree account. Sign out and sign back in as the account that requested the change.
auth.changeEmail.confirmBody: Your account will switch to {email}. Your current address stops working for sign-in as soon as you confirm.
auth.changeEmail.expired: This email change link has expired. Request a new one from account settings.
auth.changeEmail.used: This email change link has already been used.
auth.changeEmail.invalid: This email change link is not valid.
trees.error.title: We could not load your trees
trees.error.message: Your groves are still safe. The connection to the server may have dropped.
trees.title: The families you keep.
trees.subtitle: Each tree is a private graph. Invite relatives to add stories, photographs and the connections between them.
trees.startAnotherHint: A separate branch for another side of the family.
trees.empty.title: Plant your first tree
trees.empty.body: Add the people you remember, connect parents and partners, then invite a relative to help fill in the branches.
trees.deleted.title: Recently deleted
trees.deleted.subtitle: These trees are kept for 30 days. Restore one any time before the date shown.
trees.deleted.erasedNextRun: Erased on {date} at the next maintenance run.
trees.deleted.erasedOverdue: Erasure is overdue and will run shortly.
trees.deleted.ownerOnly: Restoring needs an owner. Ask one of the owners to restore it.
trees.deleted.noneActive: You have no active trees right now.
tree.create.title: Start a family tree
tree.create.description: Give this branch a name. You can invite relatives once it exists.
tree.create.name: Tree name
tree.create.descriptionHint: Optional. A few words about this branch.
tree.create.descriptionPlaceholder: From the old country to here.
tree.create.created: Tree created. Add your first person.
tree.import.title: Import a GEDCOM file
tree.import.description: Creates a new tree from a GEDCOM 5.5.1 file. Nothing in your existing trees changes. Media files and sources are not imported.
tree.import.fileHint: A .ged file, up to 5 MB. The app reads the text, then creates the tree on the server.
tree.import.errorTooLarge: That file is larger than 5 MB.
tree.import.errorNoPeople: No people were found. Check that this is a GEDCOM file with INDI records.
tree.import.errorUnreadable: That file could not be read as text.
tree.error.title: We could not load this tree
tree.error.message: The tree may be temporarily unavailable. Try again, or head back to your trees.
tree.refresh.pending: Another member changed this tree. It will refresh when you close this dialog.
tree.empty.title: An empty branch
tree.empty.bodyEditable: Add the first person. From there you can connect parents, partners and children.
tree.empty.bodyReadOnly: The people who manage this tree have not added anyone yet.
tree.focus.claimed: Your place in the tree is saved. The graph now opens around you.
tree.focus.cleared: Your link to this tree was cleared. Everyone is visible again.
tree.focusPrompt.title: Who are you in this tree?
tree.focusPrompt.body: Pick yourself and the tree will open around your part of the family. Everyone can still see the whole tree with one click.
tree.conflict.title: Some relationships contradict each other
tree.conflict.bodyOwner: The graph may look wrong until you fix one of these links.
tree.conflict.bodyEditor: The graph may look wrong until an editor fixes one of these links.
tree.conflict.partnerAncestor: {first} is both partner and ancestor of {second}.
tree.face.none: No faces found in this photo.
tree.delete.title: Delete {name}?
tree.delete.eventMessage: The life event will be removed from this person's timeline.
tree.delete.personMessage: This removes the person and their connections. Their photos move to the tree inbox so you can file them under someone else. This cannot be undone.
tree.delete.fileMessage: The file will be removed from storage and from this person's profile.
tree.delete.albumMessage: Every file in this album will be removed from storage. This cannot be undone.
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.description: Choose the language for the app.
